test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A coat marked at Rs. 145 is offered at Rs. 127.6. The rate of retail discount offered is:
solution:
**Given:**

Marked price of the coat = Rs. 145

Offered price of the coat = Rs. 127.6

**Concept:**

The rate of retail discount is calculated using the formula:

Discount Rate (%) = [(Marked Price - Offered Price) / Marked Price] × 100
